功能介绍
Town Cats 会在鹈鹕镇中加入会自由活动的猫咪。
猫咪平时会在小镇中游荡、休息，当两只猫距离过近时，可能会开始争吵。争斗会经历[b]哈气、扑击、打架、恢复对峙[/b]等阶段，并且有一定概率继续下一轮。
玩家可以使用[b]有水的水壶[/b]浇正在哈气或恢复中的猫，将它们驱散。猫也会受到墙体、建筑、玩家、NPC 和其他障碍物影响，不会隔着障碍直接触发争斗。
玩家可以邮件两只打架的猫进行劝架，会触发对话有概率劝架成功。
主要功能：
[list]
[*]在
[code]Town[/code]地图随机生成猫咪[/*]
[*]默认生成 8 只，可调整为 0–40 只[/*]
[*]猫咪会游荡、睡觉、争吵和逃跑[/*]
[*]两只猫靠近后可能自动触发争斗[/*]
[*]支持人皇步吸附、哈气、扑击、打架云团、恢复等阶段[/*]
[*]可以使用水壶驱散部分争斗状态[/*]
[*]带有距离和左右声像变化的哈气声音[/*]
[*]支持多人联机同步[/*]
[*]午夜后猫咪会停止争斗并寻找位置休息[/*]
[*]允许使用鱼投喂小猫[/*]
[/list][b]适用版本：Stardew Valley 1.6、SMAPI 4.0 或更高版本。[/b]
多人联机时，[b]房主和所有玩家都需要安装相同版本的 Mod[/b]。

English
[heading]Features[/heading]
Town Cats adds roaming cats to Pelican Town.
Cats will normally wander around and rest. When two cats get too close, they may start a dispute and go through several stages, including [b]hissing, lunging, fighting, and recovery[/b].
Players can use a [b]watering can with water[/b] to break up cats during certain stages. Walls, buildings, players, NPCs, and other obstacles can also block cats from detecting each other.
Main features:
[list]
[*]Random roaming cats on the
[code]Town[/code]map[/*]
[*]8 cats by default, configurable from 0 to 40[/*]
[*]Cats can wander, sleep, fight, and run away[/*]
[*]Nearby cats may automatically start disputes[/*]
[*]Hissing, lunge, fight-cloud, and recovery stages[/*]
[*]Watering can interaction to break up certain fights[/*]
[*]Positional hissing audio with distance and stereo panning[/*]
[*]Multiplayer synchronization[/*]
[*]Cats stop fighting and look for a place to sleep at midnight[/*]
[*]Allows you to feed kittens fish. [/*]
[/list][b]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0 or later.[/b]
For multiplayer, [b]the host and every connected player must install the same version of the mod[/b].
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/b].[/*]
[*]Extract
[code]TownCats-0.1.0-beta.zip[/code].[/*]
[*]Move the entire
[code]TownCats[/code]folder into:[/*]
[/list][code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code]The final folder structure should look like:
[code]Stardew Valley/
└─ Mods/
   └─ TownCats/
      ├─ manifest.json
      ├─ TownCats.dll
      └─ ...[/code]Do not place it inside an extra nested folder such as:
[code]Mods/TownCats/TownCats/[/code][list=1]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Press [b]F8[/b] after loading a save to change the number of cats.
If F8 conflicts with another mod, use the SMAPI console command:
[code]towncats_config[/code]To check the current cat status:
[code]towncats_status[/code]This is currently a [b]Beta[/b] release. For multiplayer issues, keep the SMAPI logs from both the host and affected clients.
